semantics: Exact least number of gates of a circuit that is right on the n*m inputs with exactly one row wire and one column wire on (Lean: PEqualNP.Represents.Represents). "mono": AND/OR gates of fan-in at most two (Monotone2, RepSizeAtMost). "not": AND/OR/NOT gates, NOT counted (FanInTwo). Constants cost a gate, a missing wire reads false, the output may be an input wire or a missing wire. Inputs: the 10 stars (wires 0..9: left/row vertices, then right/column vertices). Witnesses are .ckt texts (toolkit/FORMAT.md). "exact": true means every smaller size was refuted exhaustively in the full model; otherwise "lower" is the proved lower bound and "size" the best circuit found (or null).
symmetry: row permutations, column permutations, and transpose (group order 28800)
rows_convention: bit v of rows[u] = A u v; the class representative is the member with the least value of sum_u rows[u] * 2^(m*u)

complement_gap.note: 606 complement pairs have an entry that is only bounded ([lower, best-found], listed in "open_pairs"); "max_gap_exact_pairs" is over the pairs with both sizes exact. "holds" is true when no pair is violated and, for every pair that is not exact, (best circuit of one) - (proved lower bound of the other) <= bound both ways ("undecided_by_bounds" empty), which proves the bound for every graph of this size.
